/ /dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gnyis myu+ur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: // dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gnyis myu+ur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/ rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi lhan thabs zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las/ sbyor ba'i chos la bdag bskyed kyi sman raka gtor gsum dang*/ bum pa gnyis kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa'i nang du bum rdzas nyer lnga dang chu gtsang gis sum gnyis bkang ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rten sgrub dbang la zhi khro'i dbang phreng nas bshad pa ltar/ sa chog sta gon dang bcas pa'i rdul tshon nam/ skabs 'dir ras bris la brten pa ste/ de'i mthar mchod pas bskor/ rnam rgyal shar sgo'i g.yas dang las bum g.yon/ slob dpon gyi nye logs su dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ zhi khro'i sku rten spel ma gnyis tshan/ gdong g.yogs/ me tog /rdor dril/ til/ yungs kar/ bye ma/ khrus ras/ shel rdo/ me long sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bsags pa ni gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi dbang du byas la/ sgrub dbang gi rdzas dang bsham tshul ni dbang gi phreng ba ltar bya'o// de nas sgrub pa po stan bde bar 'dug la dngos gzhi ni/ bdag bskyed rtsa gsum las byang gi sngon gtor nas rdzogs rim yan grub par byas la// bum bskyed ni bum pa gnyis kyi nang du rgyun 'bab kyi chu dang*/ bum rdzas nyer lnga chang dang 'o ma cung zad bsres pas sum gnyis bkang ba'i rnam rgyal gyi steng du dung zhal dri chus bkang ba'i steng du rdo rje la me tog dang bcas pa'i srad bu btags pa'i sne slob dpon gyis bzung la bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa gnyis las/ rnam rgyal gyi nang du lte bar mthing ga mu khyud ser po can gyi zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par gyur gyi bar mdun bskyed ltar dang*/

las bum gyi nang du pad nyi rgya gram gyi gdan la hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon khro 'dzum mche ba gtsigs shing phyag gnyis bdud rtsi thal sbyar gyi bar du bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa zhi ma khro'i rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de ltar gsal ba'i lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar mdun bskyed ltar bsgom/ mchod pa ni/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam rol lha mo mchod yon ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje mchod yon ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar sbyar ba'i sngags rgyas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ ming gzugs rnam shes tshor ba 'du shes dang*// 'du byed ngo bo khams lnga rnam dag pa'i// ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bcom ldan 'das// rtag pa la sogs de bzhin gshegs phyag 'tshal// dug lnga gnas bsgyur rigs kyi khro bo'i tshogs// rig pa'i sku las mdangs rtsal shar ba'i lha// rang rang yum bcas brjid bsgyings gar gyis rol// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// las kyi rigs las khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil// bdud rtsi thal sbyar bum bzang chu rgyun gyis// sdig pa'i dri ma 'khrud cing bgegs tshogs 'joms// las rab rdzogs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzung thag la 'khril te song*/ bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim pas rgyud bskul te bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur par dmigs nas/ zhi khro'i bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de rjes/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces las bum la dmigs te brgya stong bzla/ mthar mchod cing bstod la/ dung zhal gyi chu rnam rgyal bum pa'i lhar mchod yon phul bas/

lha rnams bde stong chen po'i ngo bor zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig par gyur/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pas 'dir ji srid dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig /ces phrin las bcol/ de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang rtsig pa rim pa lnga ldan/ 'dod snam dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo du ma 'khod cing*/ gser gyi pha gu la rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i steng du rin po che'i dra ba dang dra phyed/ de'i steng du ba ku li sngon po la ril ba rnam pa dkar pos spras pa'i steng du mda' yab dang bcas pa la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyis mdzes pa/ sgo bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa bre/ chos 'khor gdugs/ tog gis mdzes pa'i khyams chen phyogs mdog gi nang du gser gyi khyams chen mdzes pa'i dbus su/ dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang thod pa'i rtsig pa 'dod snam dang pha gu zhag gis byugs pa/ rgyu ma dang sbrul gyi dra phyed/ zhing chung dang keng rus kyi shar bu/ zhing chen dang thod pa'i kha bad la gnam lcags kyi mda' yab/ mun pa'i sgo khyud la/ zhing gi ka ba/ pags pa'i ka rgyan/ rta babs sgo khang dur khrod kyi bkod pa dang ldan pa'i thog byur bur byas pa la/ rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa'i nang gi khyams khrag chen 'khyil ba'i dbus su/ gru chad ljang khu 'od 'bar bas mdzes pa'i phyi rol du/ sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad dang de'i phyi rol rdo rje ser po'i phreng ba'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me kha dog sna tshogs 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa/ gzhal yas khang nang ma'i gru chad kyi steng du/

lte ba mthing ga mu khyud ser po can gyi chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa rtsibs kyi phyi rol du 'od lnga'i mu khyud dang ldan pa'i dbus su seṅge/ pad 'dab shar du glang chen/ lhor rta mchog /nub tu rma bya/ byang du shang shang gis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa'i/ gdan dbus mar 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ shar du rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ lhor rin po che ser po trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ byang du rgya gram ljang gu āḥs mtshan pa rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas dngul gyi 'khor lo dkar po thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas bai ḍūr+ya'i rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po g.yas byu ru'i rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas g.yu'i rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga ka'ang longs sku'i cha byad can dar dang rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i mdun gyi seṅge'i khri'i thad du tshangs pa pad nyi'i gdan la/ bud+dha he ru ka smug nag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon dung khrag /yum bud+dha kro dhī shwa rī dang sbyor ba/

rtsibs shar du dri za pad nyi'i gdan la badz+ra he ru ka mthing nag g.yas rdo rje g.yon dung khrag /yum badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī dang sbyor ba/ lhor gshin rje pad nyi'i gdan la rat+na he ru ka ser nag g.yas rin po che g.yon dung khrag /yum rat+na kro dhī shwa rī dang sbyor ba/ nub tu klu dbang pad nyi'i gdan la pad+ma he ru ka dmar nag g.yas pad+ma g.yon dung khrag /yum pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī dang sbyor ba/ byang du gnod sbyin pad nyi'i gdan la karma he ru ka ljang nag g.yas rgya gram g.yon dung khrag /yum karma kro dhī shwa rī dang sbyor ba// yab rnams dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis brgyan cing khro tshul zhabs bgrad 'gying bag gis bzhengs pa/ yum rnams gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud cing*/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ gzig lpags kyis smad dkris pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ de ltar gsal ba'i lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang bar hā ljang gu rnams las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐ */ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur/

sku gang gnyis 'dzin gyi rang rtog sbyangs/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las lha so so la rang rtags kyi phyag rgyas dbu brgyan par gyur par bsams la/ mchod pa ni/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub cing*// zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod yon rgya mtsho'i tshogs// yon tan rgya mtsho'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas la// dad pa rgya mtshos dbul lo dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar sbyar ba'i sngags rgya dang bcas pas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ gti mug mkha' khams rnam dag pa// ming gzugs ngo bo de bzhin rigs// bya rtsal rdzogs pa'i sems dpa' mchog /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la// zhe sdang chu khams rnam dag pa// rnam shes ngo bo rdo rje'i rigs// 'gyur ba med pa'i sems dpa' mchog /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la// nga rgyal sa khams rnam dag pa// tshor ba'i ngo bo rin chen rigs// sna tshogs 'byung ba'i sems dpa' mchog /phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la// 'dod chags me khams rnam dag pa// 'du shes ngo bo pad+ma'i rigs// rnam par grol ba'i sems dpa' mchog /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// phrag dog rlung khams rnam dag pa// 'du byed ngo bo las kyi rigs// lhun gyis grub pa'i sems dpa' mchog /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la// rig pa rang grol khro bo ni// skye med sku yi rigs kyi lha// bud+dha kro dhī yum dang sbyor// phyag 'tshal de bzhin khro bo la// rig pa mtha' grol khro bo ni| |brjod med thugs kyi rigs kyi lha// badz+ra kro dhī yum dang sbyor// phyag 'tshal rdo rje khro bo la// rig pa mnyam grol khro bo ni// lhun grub yon tan rigs kyi lha// rat+na kro dhī yum dang sbyor| |phyag 'tshal rin chen khro bo la// rig pa kun grol khro bo ni// bde chen gsung gi rigs kyi lha// pad+ma kro dhī yum dang sbyor// phyag 'tshal pad+ma khro bo la// rig pa yongs grol khro bo ni// yongs rdzogs phrin las rigs kyi lha// karma kro dhī yum dang sbyor// phyag 'tshal las kyi khro bo la// zhes bstod la/

snod kyi 'jig rten ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs su gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi zla'i gdan la rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan so so'i dbus su sa bon gyi mthar rang sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ snang srid zhi khro'i lha tshogs mchod cing byin rlabs mthu stobs tshe bsod dpal 'byor ma lus pa bsdus nas rang gi thugs kar thim pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ hū?m̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ pañtsa ma hā kro dha sa ma ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes ci nus long skabs dang bstun la bzla'o// de nas dbang rgyas pa sta gon gzhi dang 'brel ba ni gzhung du gsal/ 'dir mdor bsdus gshin po sogs skabs don 'ga' zhig la nyer mkho'i phyir gzhan rjes 'dzin gong du/ bdag 'jug blang ba ni/ las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ me tog dang bcas pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbul/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad par bsams la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas/ bla ma kun bzang zhi khro dang*// yi dam ḍā ki chos skyong tshogs// thugs rjes bdag la brtser dgongs te// dkyil 'khor du ni gzhug par 'tshal// zhes gsum zhu/ bla mas/ kye/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon/ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'jug spro bas// khyod kyi las 'khrul bag chags zad// 'bras bu tshe 'dir thob par 'gyur// zhes brjod/ slob ma'i gdong bcing zhing mgor rdo rje bzhag la/ hoḥ zhi khro rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du// gzhug cing byin dbab dbang mchog sbyin// dngos grub sna tshogs khyod la 'byung*// zhi khro rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor dang*// bla med gsang ba'i man ngag rnams// snod min bshad na na raka ltung*// zhes gsang bar gdams/ slar phan yon dang nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ slob ma'i snying ga dang mgor rdo rje bzhag la/

hoḥ kun bzang zhi khro ye shes lha// ye nas rang byung khyod la rdzogs// dam tshig nyams na de la sgrib// de bas dam tshig gces par srungs// zhes bsgrags/ slar gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ dung zhal du chang la a mṛ ta btab pa khar sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu// bu khyod la ni sbyin par bya// dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob// ma bsrung dmyal ba'i rgyu yin phyir// las kyi gshin rje ma rungs pa// lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgur sprul// khyod kyi snying khrag 'thung 'gyur zhing*// rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'tshed par byed// de bas dam srung chu 'di 'thung*// a mṛ ta sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig /sa ma ya i dan+te na rak+kan// zhes sbyin/ slob mas sngags thog ma'i rjes zlos kyang bya/ slar slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rdo rje slob bu'i lag tu gtad la/ hoḥ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi// bsgrub bya'i dkyil 'khor nga yin te// nga la brnyas nas tshe 'phos na// na raka ltung bar gdon mi za// zhes bsgrags/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ slob mas/ na mo/ bde gshegs zhi khro rigs bsdus lha// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bcas| |rtsa ba gsum gyi slob dpon la// bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// gsum dang*/ sems bskyed pa ni/ bla ma zhi khro rigs bsdus dgongs// 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// ma dang bu yi 'du shes kyis// ma bsgral bsgral dang ma grol dgrol// dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das 'god phyir// smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do| |gsum dang*/ yang*/ sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad ni// sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar// 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar// phar phyin drug gi lam zhugs te// log pa'i bsam pa rnams spangs te// 'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed gzung*// gsum dang*/ sdom gzung ni/

slob mas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dam tshig tu// skyon spang yon tan sgrub la 'bad// yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin zhing bklag /sdom srung log pa'i lta ba spang*// sku gsum dag gi dam tshig tu// stong pa zang thal dmigs med bzhag /sku dang thig le lug rgyud brten| |dgag sgrub bral ba'i ngang la gnas// lta sgom spyod gsum dam tshig tu// gtad med sems kyi rang bzhin lta// yeng med dran pa'i rgyal sa gzung*// dus su bab pa'i spyod pa spyad| |gzhi lam 'bras bu dam tshig tu// 'khrul ba'i bag chags dri ma bsal// dge bcu'i lam gyi chos spyod 'bad// chos dang rang rgyud 'dres par bsre// rigs lnga yi ni dam tshig mchog |rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*// byang chub sems ni spang mi bya// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag sbyin zhing*// theg gsum bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gzung*// gang 'dul thabs kyi 'gro don bya| |mdor na sgo gsum dge ba bsgrub// mi dge la ni gnas mi bya// zhes gsum gyis gzung*/ de nyid brtan cing gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ gnas gsum du dri'i thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rdo rje gsum du mos pa bskyed| ye shes dbab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma skad cig gis kun tu bzang po zhi khro dbyer med ma bskyed gsal rdzogs su bzhugs pa'i thugs kar dus gsum sangs rgyas zhi khro thams cad kyi thugs kyi bcud gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa bar med du 'khor ba las 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro zhi khro rab 'byams chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon nas thim zhing*/ 'khor lo drag tu 'khor bas rang lus kyang 'od du mer mer zhu bar bsam zhing rol mo bsgrags/ sbyar ba'i spos bsreg /slob dpon gyis/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī shan+ta de wa pañtsa kro dha ā we sha ya/

staṃ bha ya/ a a aḥ zhes brjod cing dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang la ltar gzhug cing phrin las gang 'grub lung bstan/ me tog dor ba ni/ cod pan thal mo'i bar bzung la/ kye/ bla ma zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams// sngon nas bdag dang gnyis med kyang*// bar du ma rig rtog pas bsgribs| |da lta lha dang zhal mjal phyir// 'brel ba gang yod lha dang sprod// pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes dor du gzhug /gang du phog pa'i rigs de nyid 'grub par lung bstan/ me tog dbus su phog na gsang mtshan rtag pa'i rdo rje/ shar mi bskyod rdo rje/ lhor rin chen rdo rje/ nub tu pad+ma badz+ra/ byang du karma ga ya/ mtshams su/ mos pa rtsal sogs gdags/ mig dbye ba ni/ slob dpon gyis gser gyi thur mas mig dbye ba'i rgyas/ hoḥ ston pa zhi khro rigs lnga yis// khyod kyi ma rig ling tog tshogs// rig pa ye shes ngang du bsal// zhi khro rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor ltos// dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥpra we sha yā mi/ zhes dbye/ dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul ba ni/ hoḥ ltos shig ltos shig legs par ltos// mthong nas dad pa rab tu skye// khyod ni las dang skal par ldan// dkyil 'khor 'di mthong dngos grub 'thob| |ces dang*/ rigs kyi bu dkyil 'khor 'di ni mtshon byed kyi dpe tsam las mi 'dug gi/ mtshon bya don ni bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor bzhugs shing*/ khyod rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched kyang rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin zhi khro'i lhar bzhugs pa ni/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten/ nang rang gi phung khams/ gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnam gsum ngo bo nyid dbyer med du bzhugs pa ngo shes par byos shig /ces go ba bskyed/ dbang dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas/

kye ma bla ma kun tu bzang*| |bde gshegs rigs lnga kun gyi dngos// gzung 'dzin dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir// bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ slob ma 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ gi rnam par slob dpon kun tu bzang po yab yum du gnas pa'i zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar bab pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par gyur pa mdun du dbang stegs seṅge'i khrir gnas par gyur par bsam/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas dbang gi lha'i rnam par spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rigs dbang lnga'i rdzas rnams bzung nas dbang bskur/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ yum bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ me tog gi char dbab par bsams la/ slob dpon gyis bum pa dang mi bskyod pa badz+ra he ru ka'i sku rnams thogs nas/ hūm̐ */ mthing gsal chos dbyings ye shes dkyil 'khor na// rnam shes ngo bo bcom ldan mi bskyod pa// rdo rje khro bo yab yum dbang bskur bas// zhe sdang rnam dag thugs mchog thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+yaḥbadz+ra kro dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ des mi bskyod pa zhi khro chu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas bsgyur/ 'gyur ba med pa'i sa thob/ chu khams rdo rje'i rigs su nges par byas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go// zhes don bshad/ dbu rgyan dang rat+na zhi khro'i sku mgor bzhag la/

hūm̐ */ ser gsal mnyam nyid ye shes dkyil 'khor na// tshor ba'i ngo bo bcom ldan rin chen 'byung*// rat+na khro bo yab yum dbang bskur bas// nga rgyal rnam dag yon tan kun thob shog /oṃ badz+ra rat+na ā ka ra rat+na kro dha mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐// zhes bskur/ des rin chen 'byung ldan zhi khro dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ nga rgyal gyi dri ma dag |tshor ba'i phung po phung po gnas bsgyur/ sna tshogs 'byung ba'i sa thob/ sa khams rin po che'i rigs su nges par byas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go// zhes don bshad/ rdo rje dang pad+ma zhi khro'i sku gnas gsum du reg cing lag g.yas su gtad la/ hūm̐ */ dmar gsal sor rtog ye shes dkyil 'khor na// 'du shes ngo bo bcom ldan snang mtha' yas| |pad+ma khro bo yab yum dbang bskur bas// 'dod chags rnam dag gsung mchog thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a mi tā bha pad+ma kro dha ma hā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ des 'od dpag med zhi khro rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ rnam par grol ba'i sa thob/ me khams pad+ma'i rigs su nges par byas/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go// zhes don bshad/ dril bu dang karma zhi khro'i sku mgo dang lag g.yon du gtad/ hūm̐ */ ljang gsal bya grub ye shes dkyil 'khor na// 'du byed ngo bo bcom ldan don yod grub// karma khro bo yab yum dbang bskur bas// phrag dog rnam dag phrin las yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ badz+ra a mo gha sid+dhi karma kro dha badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ des don yod grub pa zhi khro dril bu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ lhun gyis grub pa'i sa thob/ rlung khams las kyi rigs su nges par byas/

bya ba nan tan ye shes lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go// zhes don bshad/ rtag pa zhi khro'i sku dang rdor dril spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ */ dkar gsal me long ye shes dkyil 'khor na// ming gzugs ngo bo bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad// bud+dha khro bo yab yum dbang bskur bas// gti mug rnam dag sku mchog thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na bud+dha kro dha badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ des rnam par snang mdzad zhi khro ming gi dbang bskur ba thob/ gti mug gi dri ma dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ bya rtsal rdzogs pa'i sa thob/ mkha' khams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su nges par byas/ me long lta bu'i ye shes lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go// zhes don bshad/ des bum pa'i dbang thob/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ lus rtsa'i sgrib pa dag /lam zhi khro'i sku bsgom pa dang*/ sku'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob rung gi rten 'brel 'grig par byas so| |zhes dag pa brjod/ gtang rag dbul/ gnyis pa/ spros med gsang dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba gdab/ bla ma kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba snyoms 'jug gis byang sems bstsal bar bsams la/ bdud rtsi sbyin zhing*/ hūm̐ */ bdud rtsi byang sems rnam pa lnga// yab yum mkha' las rab spros pa// rigs kyi bu la sbyin pa yis// zag med bde bas tshim gyur cig /ces dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥpañtsa ma hā kro dha sa ma ya dzaḥ pañtsa a mṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes sbyin/ des kyang*/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod la myang*/ des yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug spros med gsang rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ ngag rlung gi dri ma dag /lam rtsa rlung gi gdams pa bsgom pa dang gsung gi dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang*| 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob rung gi rten 'brel 'grig par byas so// zhes dang*/

gtang rag dbul/ gsum pa/ rab tu spros med sher dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gong ltar gsol ba gdab/ dngos sam yid kyis rig ma bu la gtad de/ hūm̐ */ ye shes lnga ldan bde ba'i sku// kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' sbyin gyi// gsang ba sngags kyi sgrub bde mo// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes dang*/ rtsa sngags mthar/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes pas gtad/ man ngag snyoms 'jug sogs 'og sgo'i khrid ltar rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar spro na bstan/ des rab tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ dkyil 'khor rnam pa gnyis mthong*/ yid thig le'i dri ma dag /lam nor bu 'gengs shing las rgya bsten pa dang thugs kyi dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob rung gi rten 'brel 'grig par byas so// gtang rag dbul/ bzhi pa/ shin tu spros med tshig dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gong ltar gsol ba gdab/ bla mas shel rdo dang sku 'bag bstan la/ kye hoḥskal ldan bu rnams nyon// rang rig ka dag chos kyi dbyings// ma bcos gnyug ma khregs chod don// zung 'jug du ma ro gcig ngang*| |bcos lhad bral ba'i ngang du zhog /ces dang*/ rtsa sngags mthar/ ma hā mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ don cung zad bshad/ des shin tu spros med tshig gi dbang bskur ba thob/ don dam blo las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ sgo gsum gyi rtog tshogs tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag /lam khregs chod phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa dang bzhi pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob rung gi rten 'brel 'grig par byas so// gtang rag dbul/ lnga pa/ kun tu spros med kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ sngar ltar gsol ba gdab/ nyi ma rtse shar la snang mun phyed pa'i gnas su zhi khro'i sku sogs bkram/ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long slob ma'i mig la bkab la/

kye hoḥ skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams bdag la nyon// phyi dang nang gnyis gnyis su med pa'i mkhar// yang dag rdo rje'i rig pa sku gsum bzhugs// gsal zhing 'tsher la 'gyu breng lu gu rgyud// lhun grub ye shes sbubs su dbang bskur ro// zhes dang*/ rtsa sngags mthar/ sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ 'dir thod rgal gyi ngo sprod rgyas pa spro na bya/ des kun tu spros med thod rgal rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob/ snang ba dang mun pa zung 'jug mngon sum gyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ snang sems gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma dag /lam snang bzhi nyams su len pa dang srung du med pa'i dam tshig chen po bsrung ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu zung 'jug kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang thob rung gi rten 'brel 'grig par byas so// zhes don bshad dam tshig bsrung ba'i sems kyis/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dam bca'/ maṇ+ḍal dbul lo/ slob ma la bskur na skabs 'dir/ gong ltar slob ma rjes su bzung zhing*/ zhi khro'i dbang phreng thob na 'di nyid ma thob kyang sgom sgrub ni rung la/ gshin po rjes 'dzin dang sbyin sreg sogs bya dgos na 'di nyid ma thob ka med do/// / ༈ /de nas gshin po rjes 'dzin bya bar 'dod na/ tshe 'das kyi ro'am/ rus bu'am/ ming byang gang rung dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgor khrus stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bzhag la/ sbyang chas 'du byas nas/ rten bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i dus ltar gsal ba dkon mchog gsum dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la skyabs su 'gro bzhin par gyur bar dmigs la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas lcags kyu'i rgyas/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// 'tsho bar byed pa'i tshe zad cing*// lnga phung sgyu ma'i grong khyer zhig

/pha rol gnas su song ba khyod// 'khor ba'i gnas la ma chags shig /ma rungs log par 'dren pa yi// blo brid tshig la ma nyan par// lha dang slob dpon spyan snga ru// skad cig yud kyis 'dir shog cig /ces dang*/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus tshe las 'das pa'am 'das ma che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug srid pa bar do gang du yod kyang skad cig nyid la rten 'di nyid la mchis par gyur cig /nṛ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ gsum brjod/ slar| badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes gzhug /gshed dang phral ba ni/ sbyang chas chus bran la/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma g.yas su bskor zhing*/ sa rba bigh+nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsogs gsum dang*/ ting lo g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs kyis snod du dor la/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo gson gyi dus tshe la bar du gcod cing gshin gyi dus sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rigs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su ma nye bar dengs shig */gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas sreg cing brlag par gdon mi za'o// zhes dang*/ suṃ bha ni'i sngags brjod/ rol mo bsgrag /yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug /gtor ma phyir dor ro// de nas sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ mdun du me/ g.yas su til/ g.yon tu chu bzhag la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhal gdangs pa gsal ba dang*/

bsgrub bya'i rkang zhabs rlung gi lte ba'i me sbar des snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon paṃ nag po gnas pa gdungs te sna nas thon til la thim pas zhal du phul bas gsol bar gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes mtheb srin gyis til rten la g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing me chur dor/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya brjod/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ sdig pa dral ba ni/ rtsa sngags dang sgrib sbyong gzir ba'i bye mas rten la brab cing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra sho dha ni sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bhasmiṃ ku ru bruṃ bi nā shā ya/ truṃ bi sho dha ya/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ da ka da ka/ ha na ha na/ sruṃ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra hūm̐ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ bi s+pho ṭā ya bri ta bri ta/ traṭa traṭa/ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na rak+ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brab/ de nas me long nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha shar ba la las bum gyi chus khrus gsol zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang*// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ */de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta= /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de'i sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta= /khrus ras kyis phyi zhing*/

rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ de nas khrus chu slar las bum du blugs pas rten dngos su bkru ba me long du shar bar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'di ni khrus mchog= /thugs rje'i= /byin rlabs= /ci 'dod= /yon tan rgya mtsho dpag med pa'i// ting 'dzin sngags ldan khrus kyi chus// ye shes chu zla'i dkyil 'khor na// rnam shes pad+mo 'di bkrus pas// mu tig dkar po dri med ltar// dag par ma gyur gang yang med// tshe 'das lus ngag yid gsum gyi// sdig sgrib ma lus dag gyur cig /'di ni pha rol phyin drug chu// rmongs sogs dri ma kun sbyong zhing*// thams cad mkhyen sogs legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o// zhes dang*/ rtsa sngags mthar/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces brjod/ dug dbyung ni/ rten ku sha'i chun pos byab pa'i tshul gyis// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan mchog gsum dug mi mnga'// mchog gsum bden pas dug bcom mo// sa sogs dug gi pha yin te// sa sogs dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum 'byung bzhi'i nang du song*// zhes rtsa sngags mthar| tshe 'das che ge mo'i nyon mongs dug gsum thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas 'byung ba'i bag la zhi bar gyur cig /'byung ba'i ngang du thim par gyur cig /ces brjod/ de nas rigs drug gi sa bon 'od kyis sreg pa sogs spro na sgrib sbyong ye shes 'od 'phro ltar bya// slar tshe 'das kyi nye du'am mched grogs yid mthun pa zhig gis ming byang sogs bzung la phyag 'tshal zhing*/

tshe 'das kyis phyag 'tshal zhing dkyil 'khor gyi lhar skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ slob dpon gyis/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// zhes pa nas/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig |ces pa'i bar lho sgo gzhan ltar phyag bya/ de nas slob ma'i bya ba rnams tshe 'das kyis byas par bsams la sngar bshad pa ltar dbang rgyas par bskur zhing*/ bsdu na sngags la brten pa tsam yang byar rung tsam yin no// de nas skad cig gis pad zla'i gdan la tshe 'das hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa sems skyil gyis bsgyings pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod cing*/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la// zhes pas bstod la/ rten gyi mdun du bza' btung sna tshogs bshams la/ yi ge gsum dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ a kā ro gsum dang*/ hūm̐ */ tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod nyon// byams gdung yid la bcag pa'i gnyen 'dun dang*// smon lam las 'brel mthun pa'i grogs rnams dang*// yun du 'grogs pa'i las dbang skal med kyang*// brtse ba'i sems kyis longs spyod sna tshogs dang*// gter chen mi zad rgya chen gzhong pa ru// ro mchog bcud dang ldan pa'i bza' ba dang*// nyon mongs gdung ba sel ba'i btung ba bshams// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa// 'dod yon dngos 'byor yid sprul mtha' yas pa// thugs rje'i thabs dang ldan pa'i smon lam dang*// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te// tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis// bkres skom dbul phongs 'jigs pa kun bral nas// 'dod yon longs spyod dpal la spyod par shog

/ces dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i sngags rgyas mer sreg cing dbul phongs la sbyin/ de nas lam bstan cing sbyang ba ni/ kye/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// rigs drug gnas na bde ba med// sdug bsngal las la ma chags par// 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// bde ba can gyi zhing khams yod// chos dbyings rnam dag gzhal yas der// bcom ldan mgon po 'od dpag med// byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas// srid par sbyor ba yongs su zad| |rnam grol bde ba'i dngos grub brnyes// zhing gi yon tan bsam mi khyab// bu khyod de ru 'gro bar gyis// dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba'i| |dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyi// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa'i// lam lnga dag la rab brten nas// sgrib pa kun byang las sad de// bde ba can du skye bar shog /'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// bde ba can gyi zhing khams der// sems can srog ni sa dang chu// me rlung nam mkha'i rang bzhin la// de la skye shi bya ba med// de bzhin rigs kyi bu khyod kyang*| |yum lnga'i ngo bo grol gyur te// bde bo skyid do rnam dag zhing*// zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog /oṃ dz+nyā na sa ma ya satwa hrīḥphaṭa/ ces brjod/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes lha'i rnam par gnas pa dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis reg ma thag tu spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyang gis thon nas bde ba can gyi zhing du mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa'i thugs kar thim pas de'i thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam la dar cig mnyam par bzhag /tshul de lta bus zhag zhe dgu sogs su rjes su bzung rjes/ ro yin na zhi ba'i sreg chog logs su yod pa ltar bya zhing*/ ming byang yin na dpal 'bar gyis sreg cing*/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// zhes pa nas/ 'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog

/ces pa'i bar gyis bsregs la/ thal sol sāts+tsha gdab pa sogs bya'o// rjes su dkyil 'khor pa la/ mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis mchod cing*/ sngar bum mdun gyi skabs bshad pa'i bstod pas bstod/ skabs 'dir tshogs 'khor nas yig brgya'i bar rtsa gsum las byang ltar byas rjes/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur par bsam la/ slar/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis// sogs dang shis brjod rnams kyang rtsa gsum las gzhung ltar bya/ bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// de ltar zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog shin tu bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi zhi khro'i dbang gi phreng bar lhan thabs su med mi rung du yod pa/ sngon chad kun bzang dgongs 'dus kyi las byang gis kha 'gengs par 'dug kyang de nyid rung mthun tsam ma gtogs lha'i phyag mtshan sogs la 'dra min cung zad 'dug pa sogs la brten nas/ dgongs pa yang zab kyi zhi khro'i phyi sgrub kho na ltar la skabs su bab pa'i mchod bstod tsam gyis kha bskangs shing*/ slar gshin po rjes 'dzin dang*/ de la mkho ba'i dbang mdor bsdus kyang*/ rung mthun du sbyar ba 'di ni/ dbur stod 'bri gung du son pa skyu ra'i gdung gi tha shal/ chos 'di nyid la bag chags sad pa'i rigs sngags 'chang ba/ rig lam bcu phrag smra ba la bsnyengs pa med pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal pa'i sdes pho brang chen po bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba yang dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi chos sder 'du'o// //maṅga laṃ//
